author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A 26-year-old Providence woman faces charges after a hit-and-run in Pawtucket left a man critically injured, police said.

Authorities allege that Maryna Ohagan was driving a vehicle reported stolen earlier Sunday when it struck a 48-year-old man on an electric unicycle at Main and Magill streets. The injured man was taken to a hospital with life-threatening injuries.

Pawtucket police said officers had briefly pursued the vehicle after trying to stop it but ended the chase for public-safety reasons. Investigators allege the driver fled on foot after the collision. Providence police later arrested Ohagan, and Pawtucket police said she admitted involvement in the theft and crash.

Ohagan faces charges including possession of a stolen vehicle, reckless driving, leaving a crash that caused serious injury and larceny over $10,000. The charges are allegations and have not been proved in court. She is presumed innocent unless convicted, and officials have not released a later update on the victim’s condition.
dek: Police say a stolen vehicle struck a 48-year-old man riding an electric unicycle, leaving him with life-threatening injuries.
headline: Providence woman charged after Pawtucket hit-and-run
